why: Basak, Dong, Saettone & Zaharescu, 'Representations as Sums of Icosahedral and Dodecahedral Numbers: Proof of Pollock's Conjectures' (IMRN 2025, Issue 13), refutes Pollock's original bounds (13 icosahedral, 21 dodecahedral) with counterexamples (e.g. 95, 79) and proves corrected versions (15 icosahedral, 22 dodecahedral numbers suffice, both sharp).
